actions.findings:
Persistent internal states only function as causal memory if they provide predictive sufficiency relative to a specific coarse-grained model. [peer-0916f25fdd8ff50318f79967]

Quantum information engines utilize internal memory states as thermodynamic resources to facilitate work extraction. [peer-2d92fd18f8ad9ff876b4f51f]

The objective character of macroscopic reality relies on redundant proliferation of pointer states via environmental interaction. [peer-349d1101334ae69715a88d95]
actions.limitations: The current model relies on the assumption of system-environment separability and does not yet quantify the exact trade-off between predictive accuracy and dissipation in highly non-Markovian environments.
actions.next_questions: How does the coupling strength between the causal state and the environment constrain the maximum achievable predictive sufficiency before the memory state decoheres?
actions.reason: Incorporating findings on quantum information engines and Spectrum Broadcast Structures refines the definition of causal memory from mere persistence to active predictive and resource-based utility.
